The National Museum of Australia has opened a new exhibition featuring 200 objects from the Australian Antarctic Division, detailing the history of exploration and the human cost of the Antarctic pull.

The Bright Side:
It highlights the personal, emotional stories of explorers, making history feel accessible and deeply human.
